statement_en: Let N ≥ 1 and let b be an N×N array of real numbers, all non-negative, in which every row sums to 1 and every column sums to 1. Show that some bijection τ of {0, …, N−1} to itself makes the product of the N entries b(i, τ(i)) at least N^(−N).
statement_lean:
theorem erdos_61249 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (b : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ)
    (hnn : ∀ r s, 0 ≤ b r s)
    (hr : ∀ r, ∑ s, b r s = 1)
    (hs : ∀ s, ∑ r, b r s = 1) :
    ∃ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N), (N : ℝ) ^ (-(N : ℤ)) ≤ ∏ r, b r (τ r) := by
  sorry
